{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for SEVERE disease presence
has_severe = df['severity'].isin(['severe']).any()

# Check the number of -999 in biomarker_baseline
num_neg999 = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()

# Check for duplicate patient_id
num_duplicates = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()

print(f'Has SEVERE disease: {has_severe}')
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {num_neg999}')
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id: {num_duplicates}')"}
